mechanism_narrative: A persistent 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 6 consecutive months but S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of those periods, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals a supply-side expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% above its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises above its 12-month moving average but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of those instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5% but S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of those periods, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit margins and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises above 6.5% but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of those instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a dual weakness in consumer and residential demand that depresses corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 and HOUST decline but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of those periods, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average combined with a 3-month rise in the producer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals a supply-side expansion with inflationary pressures that boosts corporate earnings but raises discount rates, producing mixed S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both INDPRO and CPIAUCSL rise but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of those periods, the hypothesis is falsified.

regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with weakening demand
failure_condition: If both FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5% and GDPC1 declines but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of those periods, the hypothesis is falsified.
